Fall Meditation Retreat in Greater Washington DC: A Quiet Day Together

On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the Buddha Meditation Center of Greater Washington DC community came together for a fall meditation retreat. The day offered a chance to pause from the usual pace, settle into the present moment, and share quiet time in community.

Beautiful Fall Weather and a Moment to Pause

“Beautiful fall weather” was a simple reflection from the day. The changing season can invite us to slow down and notice what is already here: the air around us, the people beside us, and the peace that can be found when we give ourselves room to stop.

A retreat does not require us to become someone else or solve everything at once. It can begin with a willingness to arrive as we are, take a breath, and let the mind rest from its usual rushing.

A Day of Shared Practice

The value of a meditation retreat is not only in time spent quietly. It is also in the encouragement of practicing alongside others. In a community, even a small pause can become a reminder that peace and clarity are worth making room for in everyday life.

[[internal link opportunity: upcoming meditation retreats and meditation sessions]]

We are grateful to everyone who shared this fall retreat day with the Buddha Meditation Center community. May the calm cultivated together continue into daily life. May all beings be happy and free from suffering.
